meta.note: Friday briefing. Three top stories: copper rebounds after a plunge (SHFE CNY 89,300/t; LME intraday low $11,596 - an 11-month low - then rebounding to $12,089), onsemi power-device lead times over 50 weeks, and DRAM divergence (TrendForce cuts next-year contract-price growth). Event library: 6 timeline entries added, 3 new events (ZTE 1.5 MW CDU, EU hybrid-car quota, Nvidia congressional hearings). Tier B batch 12: 11 subcategories, 1 with a hit. Refrigerant spot: R32 CNY 64,500-65,500/t (Nov 25, Fluorine Online); R410A uses the Nov 23 single-point price of CNY 59,000/t (no Nov 25 spot range).

hotspot_events.title: Copper rebounds after a plunge: SHFE main contract closes at CNY 89,300/t; LME copper hits an 11-month intraday low, then climbs back above $12,000
hotspot_events.heat_reason: The SHFE main contract fell 0.51% in a day and LME copper dropped intraday to $11,596 - an 11-month low - before rebounding to $12,089, while spot premiums continued to ease; copper volatility directly hits HVAC copper costs
hotspot_events.summary: LME copper fell intraday on Nov 25 to $11,596/t (an 11-month low), then rebounded intraday on Nov 26 to a high of $12,089/t; the SHFE main contract closed Nov 26 at CNY 89,300/t (-0.51%); SMM's Shanghai spot premium averaged CNY 2,300/t on Nov 26 (-200); national copper social inventories rose back above 60,000 t.
numbers: National copper social inventories above 60,000 t (+9,100 t/week)

hotspot_events.title: onsemi power-device lead times stretch past 50 weeks, allocation only about 70%
hotspot_events.heat_reason: onsemi lead times for some products stretched from over 26 weeks at the start of the year to more than 50 weeks in October, with major customers receiving only about 70% of what they ordered, while ST's overall book-to-bill ratio is far above 2; the power-device shortage directly hits VSD and drive-board supply
hotspot_events.summary: A Nov 24 PCIM industry analysis said the AI-driven shortage has spread to legacy silicon-based power semiconductors, with shortages already visible in Q3; onsemi lead times for some products stretched from over 26 weeks at the start of the year to more than 50 weeks in October, with major customers receiving only about 70% of their MOSFET and discrete-component orders; ST disclosed an overall book-to-bill ratio far above 2 at its earnings call.
numbers: onsemi lead times over 50 weeks for some products
Major customers receiving only about 70% of orders
Infineon data-center power revenue expected near EUR 4 billion in FY2027

hotspot_events.title: DRAM diverges: TrendForce cuts next-year contract-price growth; DDR4 spot falls, DDR5 edges up
hotspot_events.heat_reason: TrendForce cut next-year DRAM contract-price growth, spot DDR4 fell while DDR5 edged up, memory stocks fell 5-6% pre-market, but server/HBM supply stays tight; the divergence signal directly affects PCBA memory part-number pricing
hotspot_events.summary: TrendForce cut next-year DRAM contract-price growth on Nov 25 (Chinese CSPs cut server DRAM demand); spot DDR4 16Gb fell 0.89% and 8Gb fell 1.61%, while DDR5 16Gb edged up 0.55%; Micron, SK hynix and SanDisk fell 5-6% pre-market on Nov 25; Dell booked $60.2 billion in AI orders last quarter with a $132.3 billion backlog, and HBM tightness continues into 2027.

industry_updates.title: Midea Building Technologies CDU earns CRAA product performance certification; first cold-plate liquid-cooling O&M white paper released the same day
industry_updates.detail: Midea Building Technologies' CDU earned CRAA product performance certification (Nov 25), covering 9 metrics including a 1.5x pressure rating and heat-exchange capacity of at least 98% of nominal; the first White Paper on Operation, Maintenance and Management Technology for Cold-Plate Liquid Cooling Systems in Data Centers was released the same day at the CDCC Data Center Standards Conference.

industry_updates.title: Midea named thermal-management partner for Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform; Shunde liquid-cooling smart-manufacturing base invests over CNY 1 billion
industry_updates.detail: Midea is a thermal-management partner for Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform (Nov 24 Foshan media report); its Shunde liquid-cooling smart-manufacturing base invests over CNY 1 billion, covering water-cooling units, CDUs and dry coolers, with production expected to start in August 2027.

industry_updates.title: China Tower's ~CNY 303 million base-station AC tender announced; Midea leads with 30%
industry_updates.detail: China Tower's ~CNY 303 million base-station air-conditioner tender was announced (Nov 25): Midea leads with 30%, followed by Haiwu 25%, Gree 20%, Skyworth 15% and Hisense 10%.

industry_updates.title: Gree interim dividend of ~CNY 5.553 billion approved at extraordinary shareholders' meeting; Dong Mingzhu says no low-price war at the expense of quality
industry_updates.detail: Gree's Nov 25 extraordinary shareholders' meeting: interim dividend of ~CNY 5.553 billion (CNY 10 per 10 shares); first-three-quarters revenue of CNY 126.544 billion (-8.07%) and net profit attributable to the parent of CNY 17.274 billion (-19.51%); Dong Mingzhu said the company will not sacrifice quality to fight on price and will stick to 'market first, factory later' for overseas plants.

industry_updates.title: Envicool investor-relations event: overseas gross margin above domestic; full liquid-cooling chain capability in place
industry_updates.detail: At Envicool's Nov 26 investor-relations event: overseas gross margin is above domestic, with a sustained improvement base as overseas volume grows; the company has full-chain, full-scenario, full-lifecycle liquid-cooling product and service capability for computing power.

industry_updates.title: Tariff-policy sweep: MOFCOM Announcement No. 59 extends Ga/Ge/Sb pause to 2027-01-27
industry_updates.detail: MOFCOM Announcement No. 59 of 2026 (published Nov 24) extends the pause on Ga/Ge/Sb export controls to the US to 2027-01-27 (effective Nov 28); the ban on US military users / military end-uses remains in force; no other finalized HVAC-relevant policies in the window; the proposed 15% US refined-copper tariff remains unapproved and the Section 301 exclusions still expire 2027-01-09.

siphon_effects.detail: ZTE launched a 1.5 MW liquid-cooling CDU + 800V HVDC (Nov 23 release / Nov 24 reports): a single unit delivers 1.5 MW, expandable to 2.4 MW, with temperature control of ±0.5°C and pressure control of ±0.05 bar; combined with 800V, PUE stays within 1.15; a Nanjing Binjiang retrofit case reaches up to 60 kW per cabinet with PUE 1.15.

DRAM diverges: TrendForce cut next-year contract-price growth on Nov 25; spot DDR4 fell while DDR5 edged up; after AI server vendors signed contracts, prices rose, with some orders up as much as 45% (CCTV Finance, Nov 23); HBM supply from the big three is basically sold out for 2027.

onsemi lead times for some products stretched from over 26 weeks at the start of the year to more than 50 weeks in October, with major customers receiving only about 70% of orders; Microchip said AI customers have booked entire factories' capacity, pushing lead times for MCUs, analog and power-management chips originally for industrial/automotive/consumer electronics to 6-32 weeks, with tightness possibly lasting until around 2028.
siphon_effects.source: MoneyDJ, Nov 25, 2026; Microchip earnings call, Nov 5, 2026

siphon_effects.detail: No new price-hike letters in the window; lead times of 40 weeks, 52 weeks for some Samsung Electro-Mechanics models; Samsung Electro-Mechanics Q4 consumer-grade X5R +25%-30%, AI-grade X6S +10%-20%; Murata's discontinuation list has a last-order date of 2028-03-31.
siphon_effects.source: TrendForce via NextPCB, Nov 12/18, 2026; Cathay Securities Futures, Nov 11, 2026

siphon_effects.detail: No new price-hike letters in the window; Taiwan Union Technology (TUC) Q4 high-end CCL price hike +5%-20% (reported Nov 9); electronic cloth 2116/1080/1078 stays tight, 1080 cloth up about 300% from its low, CCL procurement cycle 8-32 weeks.

Copper plunged then rebounded: LME copper fell intraday on Nov 25 to $11,596/t (an 11-month low), then rebounded intraday on Nov 26 to a high of $12,089/t; the SHFE main contract closed Nov 26 at CNY 89,300/t (-0.51%); SMM's spot premium averaged CNY 2,300/t on Nov 26 (-200).

cross_industry.detail: The EU announced temporary safeguard measures on Nov 24, setting a 200-day quota on imported new hybrid passenger cars until 2027-06-18; China's quota is 191,780 units, about 350,000 annualized, covering only about 40% of China's expected ~800,000 plug-in hybrid exports to Europe in 2026.

National passenger-car retail reached 984,000 units from Nov 1-22 (-25% YoY), with NEVs at 702,000 (-13% YoY) and a 71.3% penetration rate; CPCA expects November NEV retail of about 1.15 million units with penetration of about 70.6%.

cross_industry.industry: Consumer electronics (memory price hikes pass through to devices)
cross_industry.detail: DJI raised prices on some products from Nov 18, citing sustained sharp cost increases in key components including semiconductors and memory; memory's share of a phone's BOM rose from 10%-15% in a normal year to 30%-40% in 2026, with BOM costs for phones under $200 up 70% YoY, almost entirely driven by memory.

cross_industry.industry: BYD in talks to buy Ineos's Hambach plant in France
cross_industry.detail: BYD confirmed on Nov 24 that it has entered exclusive talks with Ineos Automotive to acquire its Hambach manufacturing plant in France, aiming to produce vehicles locally.

The December FOMC meeting is Dec 8-9, with the decision on Dec 9; the CME-implied probability of a 25bp December hike was 97.8% after the PCE release (Nov 25), and Polymarket put it at about 94% on Nov 26.

supplier_updates.detail: LME copper fell intraday on Nov 25 to $11,596/t (an 11-month low), then rebounded intraday on Nov 26 to a high of $12,089/t; the SHFE main contract closed Nov 26 at CNY 89,300/t (-0.51%); SMM's Shanghai spot premium averaged CNY 2,300/t on Nov 26 (-200); national copper social inventories rose back above 60,000 t (+9,100 t week-on-week) (SMM/Mysteel, Nov 26)

The SHFE aluminum main contract closed Nov 26 at CNY 21,080/t (+0.29%); LME aluminum rose about 1.45% intraday on Nov 26; the LME aluminum spot premium fell back to about $110/t (it was $405/t on Monday); LME available aluminum inventories were 205,300 t (Mysteel, Nov 26; Reuters via Boursorama, Nov 26; Huaxin Futures morning note, Nov 26)

R32 East China spot CNY 64,500-65,500/t (Nov 25, Fluorine Online daily review); Yonghe's single-plant R32 quote at CNY 64,000/t (Nov 26); the latest verifiable R410A spot price is the Nov 23 East China price of CNY 59,000/t (bulk, ex-factory), with Q4 long-term contract pricing at CNY 60,500/t; R22 spot mainstream CNY 17,000-19,000/t and weakening; no price-adjustment letters from Juhua/Dongyue/Sanmei/Yonghe in the window (Fluorine Online, Nov 25/26; Kaiyuan Securities weekly report, Nov 23)
Praseodymium-neodymium oxide CNY 730,000-733,000/t (Nov 24, Mysteel); SMM's Nov 26 daily review said rare-earth prices were mixed, with quiet inquiries and a wait-and-see mood

onsemi lead times for some products stretched from over 26 weeks at the start of the year to more than 50 weeks in October, with major customers receiving only about 70% of their MOSFET and discrete-component orders; ST's overall book-to-bill ratio is far above 2; onsemi cancelled a ~EUR 1.9 billion expansion plan in the Czech Republic (MoneyDJ, Nov 25, citing PCIM analysis)

No new price-hike letters in the window; KEMET's second round of tantalum-capacitor price hikes of 20-30% took effect Nov 1 (T520/T521/T530 series); lead times for industrial-grade aluminum electrolytic capacitors (400-450V) stretched from 10-14 weeks in August to 18-22 weeks; Yageo's new round of MLCC high-capacitance hikes is planned at over 50% (broker news from mid-October, effective from November); no new film-capacitor news in the window (PCBA procurement industry roundup, November)

No price-hike/shortage/lead-time news from Highly, Lingda or GMCC in the window; Highly only showcased a dual-cylinder inverter compressor at AWE2026 (cooling efficiency +15% under high-temperature conditions) and an R290 eco-refrigerant compressor (Refrigeration Express, Nov 23)

No price-hike/shortage/lead-time news from Sanhua, DunAn or Yinlun in the window; Danfoss showcased a full-chain liquid-cooling solution from cooling source to chip side at the CDCC conference on Nov 19-20, saying its product portfolio can cover over 70% of CDU components and custom parts (Refrigeration Express, Nov 23)

No new price-adjustment letters from Schneider, ABB, Siemens, CHINT or Delixi in China in the window; Schneider's Digital Energy price factor in Indonesia rose from 1.1 to 1.15, effective 2026-11-01 (about +4.5%, Indonesia market only)
